en:
Wait a minute, Kaito! Wasn't there someone
else who disappeared other than Rantaro?

That idiot already forgot.
<CLT=cltSTRONG>Gonta<CLT=cltNORMAL> also left during the strategy meeting.

Yeah, he locked himself up
in the <CLT=cltSTRONG>A/V Room<CLT=cltNORMAL> and—
Hey, wait a sec! "Idiot"!?
Is that right, Gonta?

Y-Yes, Gonta watch bug movie. To fill Gonta
with fight, so Gonta can fight Monokuma.

Were you trying to imagine yourself as 
a huge mantis with swords for hands?

Oh, come on! How is looking at bugs
supposed to put you in a fightin' mood!?

Terrible idea! Like puttin' ketchup
on a hotdog!
But why did you lock the door?
Cuz...Gonta need focus...
Hm? Everyone suspect Gonta? Why!?
Because you don't have an alibi!
Oh, Gonta just need alibi?

Okay! Gonta will get alibi!
Just tell Gonta where to find it!

The way this debate is going...
*this* will be difficult to refute.

Kehehe... What will you do?
Without an alibi, we'll all choose you.

Gonta, please understand that in order to
reveal the truth, you must also participate.
But...Gonta not sure where to start...

You just have to tell everyone why you couldn't
have done it.

If you're not the culprit and we all
vote for you, then we're dead too.
Our lives are riding on your word. You got this.

Okay...Gonta will try!
For everyone's sake!

Nyahahahaha!
Fight, Gonta!
Fight! Fight! Fight!
Cut it out, you fuckin' bobblehead!

<CLT=cltMIND>This debate is getting loud and heated, but if
I just focus on everyone's voice...

<CLT=cltMIND>Then hopefully, we can expose the
mastermind!
